text: {"S15":{"about":["src/backend/access/brin"],"refers":["src/backend/access/heap"],"why":"BRIN's range map uses fixed-size entries to locate the entry for a heap page arithmetically."},"S16":{"about":["src/backend/access/brin"],"refers":["src/backend/access/heap"],"why":"BRIN compares its summary index tuple with an inserted heap tuple in a summarized range."},"S17":{"about":["src/backend/access/brin"],"refers":["src/backend/access/heap"],"why":"BRIN updates its summary index when a new heap tuple falls outside the recorded summarization data."},"S18":{"about":["src/backend/access/brin"],"refers":["src/backend/storage/page"],"why":"BRIN decides whether its updated index tuple can be replaced in-place based on available page space."},"S19":{"about":["src/backend/access/brin"],"refers":[],"why":"BRIN updates its range map to the replacement tuple and removes the old tuple."}}
